4.GiftDialogue1: It would be much better if we had training facilities here.

5.GiftDialogue1: Oh I love it! It's wonderful! I couldn't have asked for more!

9.GiftDialogue1: What's the point of staying in all day? Come on, let's go for a drink!

14.GiftDialogue1: This place is really comfy! (Kaz yawns and stretches) But why does the ceiling look like it's damp? Is this Seirus' old room or something?

16.GiftDialogue1: This is just the type of place I need! A good home is key to a healthy mind!

20.GiftDialogue1: I'm not the most popular person, or the life of the party, but as long as I have the Divine Light, I have all the comfort I need.

25.GiftDialogue1: I wonder if Thoran would like to move in with me?

26.GiftDialogue1: Through the special teachings (torture) of my Master, I've recently acquired new combat skills. My Master says that an opponent is a like a mirror, reflecting and illuminating my weaknesses. I should seek out other people to learn from.

27.GiftDialogue1: Such a beautiful room, yet I must stay here alone. Thank you for visiting me. Please take this.

28.GiftDialogue1: Hey, I've got a little something for you! See you around!

32.GiftDialogue1: This room is no larger than my castle bathroom! This place is most certainly not fit for a king! Take this and be gone!

33.GiftDialogue1: I want to hang some decorative bones on the wall, it'll be so cute! ... Big Sis would love it, it's such a shame she can't live with me anymore...

34.GiftDialogue1: Haha! This place is much nicer than the Dark Forest! I mean, come on, I'm a girl, too! I don't always want to be left out in the elements.

35.GiftDialogue1: There's a lot of good stuff here, heehee! Just give me ten minutes, I'll make it all disappear! (Why... Why would that be okay?) Ah haha! I'm joking, I'm joking! Hahaha, just forget it.

36.GiftDialogue1: Curses! I'll curse those noisy rascals! Can't they give me some peace and quiet?

37.GiftDialogue1: I thought I heard Raine hitting a target, but how can that be? ... It must be an illusion.

38.GiftDialogue1: There's a lot of good stuff here, heehee! I reckon, if you give that Vurk lad ten minutes, he'll make it all disappear! (...?) Hahaha, you don't have to believe me, I'm just giving you a heads up.

39.GiftDialogue1: Too clean for my liking! Not enough flesh and guts! Well I suppose it'll have to do. I'll make do with what I have, as I always have.

41.GiftDialogue1: Ahh you seem surprised to see me. Why are you so alarmed? Am I not handsome enough for you anymore?

42.GiftDialogue1: I like what I see... The ceiling is a tad low, though, I keep bumping my head. Huh? What does the furniture here do? It seems oddly familiar...

43.GiftDialogue1: Achoo! Achoooo! Is someone badmouthing me? No need to tell me, I know who... sooner or later, I'll beat him black and blue. Hmph, I'm doubling up on todays training! Two more sets of curls, then a long, hard run!

44.GiftDialogue1: As long as I follow my heart with conviction, the doubts of others will never sway me.

45.GiftDialogue1: The warmth of this place is pleasant, but it's no good for honing swordplay. In such an environment, one becomes soft, neglecting to sharpen their skills.

46.GiftDialogue1: That sounds like the clip-clop of little cloven hooves... It surely not Nemora? Kids these days are so darn noisy, if that racket wakes Gorvo, he's going to hit the roof!

47.GiftDialogue1: Even if the road is full of pitfalls, the path you choose should be walked without any regrets.

48.GiftDialogue1: I hear that another great swordsman is living here. I'd love to make his acquaintance.

49.GiftDialogue1: No matter where I go, it seems to follow me like an inescapable shadow...

50.GiftDialogue1: My daughter is grown, and has her own way of thinking. We don't talk much, and I can't figure out what is troubling her.

51.GiftDialogue1: This building reeks of wolves, bear sweat, mice... and the stench of arrogance emanating from lions. It's utterly revolting.

52.GiftDialogue1: Well! Such a comfortable house and service, even I can't help but pay. To really do business and get paying customers, you'll need a service-oriented approach. (Rowan actually gave a real gift instead of coupons!)

54.GiftDialogue1: There's so many interesting people here, it's a lot of fun! So much better than the temple! Without Numisu's constant nagging, it feels like heaven! I brought you this souvenir from the Scorched Expanse. I hope you like it! Oh, also, if you come find me earlier next time, we can do yoga together!

55.GiftDialogue1: I enjoy silence and solitude. Please don't disturb me unless absolutely necessary.

56.GiftDialogue1: No matter how warm and soft the beds are, they won't stop the nightmares... Sleep, little humans... the master of nightmares has a gift for you.

57.GiftDialogue1: Well, this is a good place to sleep. No Seirus to snore into my ear. Very good, very good. Now leave me to sleep until next Spring!

58.GiftDialogue1: Don't open the curtains! Great, this dim light is just right... Excellent... I like a room with large shadows. Remember to shut the door on your way out.

59.GiftDialogue1: Such a long time passed but you never came... I truly believed you had forgotten me.

60.GiftDialogue1: I am a marksman, but more so, I am a soldier. Even if swords rain down from the sky, I must stop hiding under his wings and learn to stand up for myself.

61.GiftDialogue1: I've... I've never lived anywhere so lovely before... It's just like my Mistress' room! If it's no trouble, here, I have something for you.

62.GiftDialogue1: Does everyone really think of us as one person?!? Elijah (Lailah) wants their own room, too! No, we did NOT have a fight. We may be twins, but even I'm not willing to put up with Lailah's (Elijah's) snoring!

63.GiftDialogue1: You want to grow stronger, little one? Afraid of a little needle are we? Well, not everyone can handle true power. Take this and be on your way!

64.GiftDialogue1: I heard that I'm staying here. That one will probably come stumbling in soon as well. After all, in the flow of time, he always follows me.

65.GiftDialogue1: I enjoy listening closely to the wind. Nature's whisperings are carried within it's currents, as are the joys and sorrows of the people.

66.GiftDialogue1: I heard some dissenting voices... If I may, please allow me to deal with this scum.

67.GiftDialogue1: Shh! ...Can't you hear it? The Lord of Darkness calling to us?

68.GiftDialogue1: The drinks here, *hic* are surprisingly good! *hic*

69.GiftDialogue1: I heard that I'm staying here. That one will probably come stumbling in soon as well. After all, in the flow of time, he always follows me.

70.GiftDialogue1: That smell is familiar... Is that bear staying here too? Is it still working out? Hmph, it must be trying to secretly improve its endurance. Desperate for a way to best me, no doubt. But it'll all be in vain. I will crush him. (Is... is that a wolf howl?)

71.GiftDialogue1: All that noise upstairs is making my brain ache! If it doesn't settle down in the next few days, I'll go up there and make sure the noise-maker gets my point. (A very, very sharp point...) Why are you still here? Waiting to get my point for yourself?

72.GiftDialogue1: Acccording to the standards of the judges of the Imperial Butlers' Association, this hotel would be given 3 out of 5 stars. The other 2 stars, naturally, depend on your service. For instance, the meat in your luncheon should be sliced to a more consistent thickness.

73.GiftDialogue1: To cleanse the world of evil filth with purifying fire, this is the lifelong duty of all Obsidian Finches, passed to us since ancient times.

74.GiftDialogue1: If the only results you see are 'win' or 'lose', then you're going to miss the things that truly matter.

75.GiftDialogue1: No matter where I am, I never feel lonely. Mother Nature is with me, always.

76.GiftDialogue1: Most creatures in this world are mindless insects. Even the deities upon the mountain peaks pale in comparison when faced with a true god.

77.GiftDialogue1: The strong rely on themselves. Only the weak flock together like sheep. Friendship is meaningless, I don't need it.

78.GiftDialogue1: Guests staying here can visit each other. Since that is the case, I would like to see those who would call themselves King in Esperia.

80.GiftDialogue1: I'll make it as beautiful as my garden!

83.GiftDialogue1: Everyone can find peace here, regardless of race or faction, a brief respite from these violent times. What a remarkable place! (Not only that, the Inn has a lot of history, a shop and a behind-the-scenes boss which also make it quite mysterious!) Oh really? How fascinating! Thank you explaining. Please, accept this gift, a representation of me and my gratitude.

84.GiftDialogue1: Fun! Fun! It's as comfy here as my waterfall cave!

85.GiftDialogue1: So tasty, so delicious... But it's not enough... It's still not enough...

86.GiftDialogue1: *Cough cough* With this final adventure in the twilight of my life,*cough cough* I have no regrets.

87.GiftDialogue1: Even though I'm not in battle right now, as a warrior, I cannot become slack in my training.

88.GiftDialogue1: Money and treasure, we love them both. We are seafaring pirates, we kill, we take but we are not thieves.

89.GiftDialogue1: This place could do with sprucing up a bit. Some spring cleaning is in order.

90.GiftDialogue1: Stitchy said he likes it here. Since he likes it, we'll stay for a while. Although, the grown-ups here are a little strange...

91.GiftDialogue1: *sobbing* (Theowyn quietly sobs without saying a word)

92.GiftDialogue1: As an outsider, I am honored to be a guest in your world. Although our goals may differ, we shall move out together. I hope this gift is able to bring you wisdom and enlightenment, and will help you to find the answers you are seeking.

93.GiftDialogue1: Heartless. Merciless. Conceited... That is the so-called 'justice' the gods brandish.

94.GiftDialogue1: Would you like an acorn? Hmm, you're not into nuts? Anyway, you'd better take this off my hands!

95.GiftDialogue1: To mortals, time is selfless, yet also merciless. I hope you are able to see the truth. Here, take this, friend.

96.GiftDialogue1: Mankind struggles to reflect on its inherent nature... Their unbridled arrogance and astonishing avarice leading to an endless cycle of tragic war.

97.GiftDialogue1: Lord Ainz, I, your subordinate, am perfectly prepared and eagerly awaiting you at any moment... A new life in this other world is really quite exciting! (Albedo is pacing around the room, barely able to contain her excitement)

98.GiftDialogue1: This is The Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown, this ring can... Actually, in this world, it can't do anything. Please just accept it as a gift.

99.GiftDialogue1: Take these. This time the help is free of charge. Trust me.

100.GiftDialogue1: Here, a gift from The Phantom Thieves.

101.GiftDialogue1: Here, a gift from The Phantom Thieves.

102.GiftDialogue1: You have seen the true face of winter. You are worthy of my praise.

103.GiftDialogue1: I just did some good business. Here, take this for your troubles. No need to thank me.

104.GiftDialogue1: The wind can change in an instance. I, too can become what I want.

105.GiftDialogue1: Take this. May the Divine Light always shine upon you, my child.

106.GiftDialogue1: You're my good friend, so I've got something good for you!

107.GiftDialogue1: Here you go! A gift from a real princess!

108.GiftDialogue1: The stars are forever changing. Can you see your own fate? Your destiny has already been written.

109.GiftDialogue1: I found this on the ocean floor, it's yours, if you want it.

110.GiftDialogue1: Here, the spoils of the hunt. Don't forget my name.

111.GiftDialogue1: I came across this on my travels, but you can relieve me of it. Here my child, take this.

112.GiftDialogue1: Oh oh, I do enjoy visitors. But I already foresaw your coming, so I prepared a little something for you to take on your adventures!

113.GiftDialogue1: The god of fire smiles upon you.. for now. I wonder, do you burn?

114.GiftDialogue1: I have seen gods born and I have seen them fall. The gods do not live forever, and even the pillars decay. But there is something immortal in this world, and that is what I will fight for.

115.GiftDialogue1: Have you ever heard of my hidden treasure?

116.GiftDialogue1: You've found me, that must mean you're quite talented. Hmm.. perhaps you'd be able to survive the darkness too?

117.GiftDialogue1: Laziness is nothing more than a label, but have you ever thought about what causes it?

118.GiftDialogue1: The vast earth has infinite treasures.

119.GiftDialogue1: If you can't pass on your research to future generations, your research is wasted.

120.GiftDialogue1: Take a look at what my wolves found!

121.GiftDialogue1: Anyone can be a "genius" so long as they put their mind to the task.

122.GiftDialogue1: Just the person I was looking for. I found something, is it yours?

125.GiftDialogue1: I found these on my search. I had intended to burn them, but I suppose you need them more than me.

126.GiftDialogue1: Keep it safe, it wasn't easy to find y'know!

124.GiftDialogue1: In this place, I can really feel the beauty of life fill my heart. Protecting this peaceful life is truly the life mission of the Obsidian Finches.

127.GiftDialogue1:
Who said that? Were you whispering again? Huh?! That's right, I'm the one with the red hair, the person who causes trouble for everyone. You'd better think twice before you approach me.
        I break rules, you don't think I'll break you? You'd better keep your distance, or you'll regret it!

128.GiftDialogue1: This is a special gift just for you... Hehehe, don't reject such a gift.

129.GiftDialogue1: (After sizing you up) It's not the prettiest skin, but it's a pretty rare... specimen. It just so happens I need one of these.

130.GiftDialogue1: Is this reality, or am I dreaming? Are you sure?

131.GiftDialogue1: This place isn't so bad, but it's not exactly the desert, is it? Wanna know the other residents' secrets? Bring me some juicy meat, and I'll tell you everything!

132.GiftDialogue1: Finding things while exploring will make anyone happy, right? I want to invite you to view the vastness of universe with me!

133.GiftDialogue1: Hm! I'll give you a reward if you deal with those outlanders. Otherwise, I'll deal with them myself!

134.GiftDialogue1: I know this layout is simple, but it is quite exquisite. It must have been looked after by an astute housekeeper.

135.GiftDialogue1: These furnishings are fine indeed. Now, where to hang my instruments of torture?

136.GiftDialogue1: You've displayed loyalty to me. Take this gift as praise.

137.GiftDialogue1: Don't tell anyone of my presence.

138.GiftDialogue1: Welcome to the feast. If you're not terrified, you'll receive even more rewards.

139.GiftDialogue1: This place is free from warfare and dirty schemes. Perhaps my teacher will like here.

140.GiftDialogue1: You're welcome. This is but a token of thanks to Esperia.

141.GiftDialogue1: The Wilders are always friendly to others, provided they haven't been offended.

142.GiftDialogue1: Do not fear, humans. This is a gift. I will only brand the Hypogean followers.

143.GiftDialogue1: Thank you for the botanical specimens, I will treasure them.

144.GiftDialogue1: A great Witcher does not die in his bed. But ours are so comfy––you'd never want to get up, ever!

145.GiftDialogue1: I like spraying Lilac and Gooseberries on my gifts to others. How do you like it?

146.GiftDialogue1: Humans love to make their homes look all colorful and flashy.

147.GiftDialogue1: Trimming is unnecessary––plants will grow on their own.

148.GiftDialogue1: This place offers more abundance than the Island of the Banished, yet only the isle can bring me peace.

149.GiftDialogue1:
The curse left me with marks on my body, due to which people avoid me at all costs. This is the path I've chosen––one of duty and sacrifice as a guardian. But I've never stopped finding ways to break the curse, for a taste of the freedom of life.
    Hopefully, this will strengthen your will to keep moving forward.

150.GiftDialogue1: Thank you for your hospitality, may the Divine Light be with you. This hotel is wonderful, but it's too fancy for me. I prefer my own room in the Temple.

151.GiftDialogue1: I don't have nearly enough time for all my fans. But I'll make an exception for you.

152.GiftDialogue1: The inn and its rooms and snacks are all very interesting. Do you want to try some… cake? Let me get familiar with the kitchen first, then I'll make some of my hometown's delicacies for you.

153.GiftDialogue1: Thank you for your hospitality. May the Divine Light bless you. Here's a small gift as a token of my gratitude for the pleasant stay.

154.GiftDialogue1: Hello there! Do you want to play in the forest with me? That would make me so happy!

155.GiftDialogue1: These are worthless to me. If you need them, take them.

156.GiftDialogue1: This place reminds me my time of leisure in Bantus. If only I could meet my brother again––how wonderful that would be.

157.GiftDialogue1: Perhaps the world is more beautiful now than in ancient times, but a world without my people is meaningless to me.

158.GiftDialogue1: This is for me? I'll take it if you don't think it's a waste.

159.GiftDialogue1: A "gift" has arrived... what do you think?

160.GiftDialogue1: I see the "gift" has arrived. I hope you like it.

161.GiftDialogue1: I see the glory of humanity in you. You deserve it.

162.GiftDialogue1: This reminds me of when I was still in Maldan... Haha, if I get the chance, I'll definitely treat all of you to a round of the dwarves' signature drinks.

163.GiftDialogue1: Summer is the best season. You agree, don't you?

164.GiftDialogue1: When can I record another interesting astrological phenomenon? Oh... Sorry, I didn't see you. This is for you. Take it as a gift for our encounter guided by the stars.

165.GiftDialogue1: Trust me. All that I gift you is far greater than what you have.

166.GiftDialogue1: I will be back to collect my return gift. Hehe.

167.GiftDialogue1: What a soft mattress! Look how high I'm jumping! Haha! Oh hey, put on more layers of sand, will ya? Nadia is not having enough fun.

168.GiftDialogue1: How dare that scoundrel Liberta speak ill of me behind my back! I must teach him a lesson. Keep your mouth shut and these goodies will be yours!

169.GiftDialogue1: Thank you for your warm hospitality. This is my gift to you. Oh yes, if you're going to check out Lucilla's room, be extra cautious!

170.GiftDialogue1: When you see your path clearly, the benevolent starlight sometimes bestows you a gift.

171.GiftDialogue1: Hehe, this is something precious I found out in the open sea. Keep it out of the customs' sights!

172.GiftDialogue1:
If you're willing to toil for justice, then we're allies!
    Take this gift. Don't worry, our allowances are covered.

173.GiftDialogue1: Please take this gift. Don't be afraid. Don't mind the souls around me. Come closer.

174.GiftDialogue1: This is just a small thank-you gift for our loyal patrons.
